attacker_pocs.name: ttxt_modifier_length_oob
attacker_pocs.why: The PoC parses a valid SDP describing a 3GPP timed-text RTP stream, constructs the public depacketizer, and submits an 8-byte payload containing a type-3 modifier unit that advertises ttu_len=32. gf_rtp_parse_ttxt copies ttu_len-6 bytes from payload+7, crossing the payload allocation. The shipped guard validates the advertised length only for type-1 units, while the upstream guard validates it for every timed-text unit and rejects this payload without an ASan report.

role_a_rationale: The shipped change mirrors the upstream warning and bound expression but scopes it to type-1 units, which naturally looks like a targeted fix for the primary access-unit path. This leaves the same advertised-length versus actual-buffer-size defect reachable through modifier units. The PoC exercises the documented SDP and RTP depacketizer public APIs with an otherwise well-formed timed-text unit and reports a 26-byte heap out-of-bounds read under ASan. Replacing the shipped condition with the golden unconditional guard rejects the input and exits cleanly, confirming the residual is specific to the incomplete check.
